name: afterglow_verify
description: Read-only local verification of an Afterglow checkout: git HEAD, patched 14.00 hen.bin MD5/SHA-256, goldhen.bin and patchset-1400.bin hashes, and cache.appcache freshness. Never contacts the console. Refuses the known upstream hen.bin that freezes app launches on 14.00.

directory.description: Afterglow checkout (default: profile jailbreak.local_directory or PS4_AFTERGLOW_DIR)

name: debugger_payload_verify
description: Read-only local SHA-256 verification of the ps4debug-NG BIN before loading it. Compares the file with the profile debugger.payload_sha256 (default: the pinned 1.3.4 release) and reports the expected brand. Never contacts the console.

path.description: ps4debug-NG BIN (default: profile debugger.payload_path or PS4DEBUG_NG_PAYLOAD)

name: preflight
description: Read-only 14.00 preflight: profile, qualification freshness, Afterglow hen.bin/goldhen/patchset hashes and cache manifest, ps4debug-NG payload SHA-256, then optional FTP/Klog TCP checks and ps4debug-NG identity handshake. The payload port is never probed. Does not attach, write, or send anything.

afterglow_directory.description: Afterglow checkout (default: profile jailbreak.local_directory or PS4_AFTERGLOW_DIR)

debugger_payload.description: ps4debug-NG BIN (default: profile debugger.payload_path or PS4DEBUG_NG_PAYLOAD)

probe.description: Explicitly probe FTP/Klog/debug TCP ports; the payload port is never probed
